expected_response.note: Retention is a valid outcome; no registered bounded edit is supported by the supplied evidence.
expected_response.primary: No change to final predicted target affinity expected from retaining the incumbent; no operative reward parameter is altered.
expected_response.secondary: Validity and strain unchanged; no coordinate displacement introduced.

failure_modes: Editing pointcloud_delta_A or region attention to chase pair-kernel/joint-motion diagnostics would be a no-op or misdirected, since the executing scalar has no such term (formula_registry).

A temporal_teacher_blend edit could displace surrounding coordinates without affinity benefit, given sign-changing, non-extrapolable contrast curves (continuous:1/3/7) and negative observed_child_score_gain (joint_diagnostics:2).
Treating recorded joint-head survival credit as terminal affinity benefit would overstate an unobserved final-affinity comparison (decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available, lineage_support).
rationale: Retain the incumbent. The Analyst's own evidence does not license an operative reward edit, and the executing pointcloud scalar contains no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term (formula_registry), so the strongest reproducible signals (short-range pair shells pair_kernel_1.5/2.5, endpoint_effects:9/10; joint_innovation/internal RMS, branch_adjusted:228/230/305/307) cannot be addressed by any registered bounded edit without treating a diagnostic feature as a force the formula does not contain. The permitted edits act only through pointcloud_delta_A (curvature), region_index/temporal_region_index (landmark attention), teacher_neighbors (count) and temporal_teacher_blend; none of these is shown to move the affinity-primary objective, and the Analyst explicitly notes the unavailable decoded terminal affinity labels (decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available) and thin ancestral coverage (lineage_support), so descendant/survival credit cannot be read as final-affinity benefit. The temporal contrast curves have many sign changes, no accepted polynomial and no extrapolation (continuous:0/1/3/7, continuous_functions, curve_support), so a time-conditioned teacher blend is not defensibly better than the static incumbent within the observed support. Opposing evidence (shape_yy negative sign, branch_adjusted:158/235, endpoint_effects:4; negative observed_child_score_gain, joint_diagnostics:2) further argues against committing a coordinate edit whose expected advantage is not established. Retaining the incumbent is the defensible choice; the evidence that would change this decision is a reproducible, affinity-linked effect on a feature the executing pointcloud scalar actually contains, or a validated temporal contrast passing the curve_support fidelity rules.
